description: Neighborhood CF (Shar, experiments/neighborhood_cf) on the shared five-fold benchmark, and a small validation-only extension. Written before any extension variant was run.

original.target: mean combination inhibition over the 16 positive-dose cells and the replicate blocks of each pair and cell line
original.dose_rows: the pair-cell prediction is given to every dose row of that pair and cell line

validation: fold (k + 1) % 5 for test fold k; training folds exclude both; no refit on training plus validation

cell.purpose: similarity from the same cell line, averaged with the all-cell similarity

cf_stage.inner_selection: k, shrink and the additive ridge lambda per fold on unweighted validation pair-cell MSE, as in her predict_cf
cf_stage.criterion: pooled validation squared error of the pair-cell prediction on validation dose rows (each pair-cell weighted by its rows), over the five validation folds

none.purpose: her prediction on every dose row (reference only, not selectable)

additive.purpose: drug-by-dose-rank effects per cell line, centred within each pair-cell

partner.purpose: drug-by-own-rank-by-partner-rank effects per cell line, centred within each pair-cell

dose_stage.inputs: drug identities, cell line and each drug's dose rank (1-4) within its block; fitted on training-fold rows minus their pair-cell mean
dose_stage.inner_selection: one lambda per fold on validation within-pair-cell squared error
dose_stage.criterion: pooled validation within-pair-cell squared error over the five validation folds

rule: Each stage keeps its default unless a challenger's pooled validation criterion is at least 1% lower; among qualifying challengers the lowest wins. The two stages add without a cross term because the dose profile sums to zero within every pair-cell. The selected pair then predicts all five test folds once. Test folds are not read before the decision file exists.
